assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome.
The symptoms are paroxysmal in nature and require continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management.
The service directly addresses the documented diagnosis codes I49.9, I47.1, and I49.5.
The service is medically necessary for this patient's presentation.
